label: 多层地面
description: 在单张基准网格的目标区域内生成多层 Perlin 噪声地面，合并为单张多值网格（每层一个递增 id，重叠处取较高层），自动过滤小碎片区域。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Generates multi-layer Perlin noise terrain within the target region of a single base grid, merged into one multi-value grid (each layer an ascending id; overlaps take the higher layer), with small-fragment filtering. The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.
icon: 俯视地面俯视图，多层叠加的色块区域，深浅交替渐变，边缘有机不规则，扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 基准网格
inputs.description: 单张基础地图网格（grid[y][x]），目标区域（自动取最大值）将被地面层覆盖。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: A single base map grid (grid[y][x]); the region with the max value is filled with terrain layers. The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.

inputs.name: layerCount
inputs.label: 地面层数
inputs.description: 生成的地面层数，每层使用不同随机种子的 Perlin 噪声，合并为多值网格中的一个递增 id
inputs.description-en: Number of terrain layers; each gets an ascending id within the multi-value output grid.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.label: 二值化过滤值
inputs.description: Perlin 噪声二值化阈值（0~1），高于此值的区域视为该层地面，值越高覆盖面积越小
inputs.description-en: Binarization threshold (0~1); noise values above this mark terrain for that layer.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.label: 噪声频率
inputs.description: Perlin 噪声采样频率，值越小斑块越大越平滑
inputs.description-en: Perlin noise sampling frequency; lower values produce larger, smoother patches.

inputs.name: octaves
inputs.label: 噪声倍频
inputs.description: Perlin 噪声叠加倍频数，值越大细节越丰富
inputs.description-en: Number of Perlin noise octaves; more octaves add detail.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 随机种子，0 使用当前时间戳，每层自动偏移保证各层不同
inputs.description-en: Random seed; 0 uses current timestamp. Each layer gets a unique offset.

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 地面网格
outputs.description: 单张多值地面网格，每层一个递增 id（从基准网格 max+1 起），重叠处取较高层，其余为 0；下游可按值拆分。输入为网格列表时引擎逐张产出对应的 DataTree。
outputs.description-en: A single multi-value ground grid; each layer is an ascending id (from max(grid)+1), overlaps take the higher layer, others are 0. With a grid-list input the engine emits one per branch as a DataTree.

outputs.name: nameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 实际出现的地面层 ID 与名称映射，格式为 [{id, name, type}]，type 固定为 'tile'
outputs.description-en: Name list mapping each present layer id to a name, format [{id, name, type}], type is always 'tile'.
